trends.name: Iran War Oil Crisis Escalation
trends.summary: WTI crude surging to $97/barrel (+76% since December) with physical Oman oil hitting record $167/barrel (+72% premium). QatarEnergy may declare force majeure on LNG contracts for up to 5 years, threatening 20% of global LNG supply. Trump signals conflict will end soon, but energy markets remain highly volatile with battle damage assessments determining daily price movements.

trends.name: Mortgage Rates Hit 3-Month High
trends.summary: US 30-year fixed mortgage rates jumped to 6.22% in the March 19 week, highest since December 11, 2025, up from 6.11% prior week. This signals tightening financial conditions and potential headwinds for housing and consumer spending amid inflation concerns.

trends.name: Bond Market Crisis Signals 2008 Warning
trends.summary: Bond market is flashing signals not seen since before the 2008 financial crisis, indicating systemic stress. Combined with bearish S&P 500 technical patterns and subsurface market damage, this suggests potential major correction looming despite headline stability.

trends.name: Triple Witching & Iran War Market Collision
trends.summary: First 'triple witching' of 2026 (options/futures/index expirations) colliding with week 3 of Iran conflict creates volatility catalyst for markets. Traders bracing for wild swings as derivatives unwind amid geopolitical uncertainty and energy shocks.

trends.name: Private Credit Bubble & Valuation Risks
trends.summary: Private credit reaching record valuations with 'cockroaches' and systemic risks threatening to derail post-Iran stock recovery. AI may be the boom, but private credit could be the fuse for next financial instability, with leverage at dangerous levels.

trends.name: Fed Policy & Powell Probe Uncertainty
trends.summary: Trump signals DOJ should continue Powell probe, complicating Warsh Fed nomination and creating policy uncertainty. Powell signaled he's not going anywhere, but political pressure on Federal Reserve independence could derail rate path expectations and capital rules changes.

trends.name: FedEx Earnings Beat & Logistics Strength
trends.summary: FedEx beats on top and bottom lines, raises full-year guidance despite surging fuel costs, signaling transportation sector resilience. However, TSA staffing shortages and potential small airport closures pose emerging supply chain risks.

trends.name: Global Stocks Rally But Sentiment Fragile
trends.summary: Global stocks staging recovery off open (EFA/EEM bouncing from -2% to -1%, Russell 2000 -0.4%) but sentiment remains fragile. Japan PM warns global economy facing 'huge hit' from Iran crisis. Rally appears tentative without conviction, suggesting bears not finished.

trends.name: AI Stock Correction & Software Sector Shift
trends.summary: Figma drops 12% in two days after Google releases 'vibe design' product. Smart money fleeing software stocks after viral AI doomsday report. Accenture dismisses software apocalypse narrative, but sector rotation underway as investors seek AI moat clarity.

trends.name: Apple Defies China Slump Narrative
trends.summary: Apple's iPhone sales defy pessimistic China expectations, proving bears wrong yet again. Strong performance in key market contradicts slowdown narrative and supports tech sector resilience despite geopolitical tensions.

trends.name: Trump Student Loan & Treasury Policy Shift
trends.summary: Trump administration looking to shift student-loan responsibilities to Treasury Department, signaling major policy overhaul. Could impact education sector, consumer finances, and government debt accounting with ripple effects across consumer spending.

trends.name: Farm Sector Fertilizer Crisis & Political Risk
trends.summary: Iran war-induced fertilizer shortage threatens Republican farm state constituencies ahead of midterms. Agricultural commodity inflation and supply disruptions creating political and economic headwinds for rural America.
